takeaways: Microsoft Graph is the API layer behind nearly every Microsoft cloud service, so admins who learn its documented endpoints and permissions can automate almost anything they would otherwise click in a portal.
Hard-coded passwords and secrets remain the biggest automation security mistake; use Azure Key Vault, Azure Automation credentials or, best of all, managed identities that remove secrets entirely.
Apply least privilege everywhere: separate app registrations per service, grant only the Graph permissions an endpoint needs, and treat Azure Automation webhooks like secrets.
hook: Many organizations automate Microsoft 365 and Azure with scripts that carry hard-coded secrets and over-privileged app registrations. In this conversation, MVP Ahmed Uzejnovic shows administrators how to build secure automation with Microsoft Graph, Azure Automation, Key Vault and managed identities without trading speed for risk.
